entities.summary: The New Times is a Russian language magazine in Russia. The magazine was founded in 1943. The magazine is a liberal, independent Russian weekly news magazine, publishing for Russia and Armenia. Its chief editor is Russian investigative journalist, political scientist, writer and radio host Yevgenia Albats. The New Times is a periodical in Europe, established in 1943.
